Tests that extraction_timeout_secs config field is accepted and does not affect fast extractions

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', uri: 'https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf'), { 'extraction_timeout_secs' => 300 })
puts result.results[0].mime_type.inspect
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
